title: PayPal Q2 2026 results furnished on Form 8-K
excerpt: Q2 total payment volume increased 10%, free cash flow was USD 1.775 billion, and full-year non-GAAP EPS guidance increased to about USD 5.38.
summary: The unchanged SEC-filed Q2 results release remains the latest issuer operating evidence for volume, margins, active accounts, free cash flow and full-year guidance.
